Liability and Claims Procedure

Important Limitations

Please read this section carefully as it limits our liability and outlines the procedure for making claims regarding lost or damaged items.

6.1 Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, the total aggregate liability of the Service Provider, and consequently our liability as agent, for any loss of or damage to your garments, shall not exceed fifteen (15) times the cost of cleaning the affected item or five hundred pounds (£500), whichever is lower. Under no circumstances will compensation exceed the original purchase value of the item, for which you may be required to provide proof of purchase.

6.2 Claims Window

Any claim for lost or damaged items must be notified to us in writing within 48 hours of delivery of your Order.

6.3 Claims Process

  • Upon notification, we will arrange for the collection of the affected item(s) for inspection by the Service Provider.
  • The Service Provider will assess the cause of the damage and, where possible, recommend and perform remedial work at their discretion.
  • If the damage is not remediable or you are dissatisfied with the outcome, compensation will be considered in accordance with clause 6.1.
  • In the event of a dispute regarding the cause of damage, we reserve the right to seek an independent expert evaluation, the findings of which shall be final and binding.

6.4 Proof of Purchase

Compensation for lost or damaged items is conditional upon you providing satisfactory proof of purchase (e.g., a receipt or bank statement). Claims cannot be processed without such evidence, which must be submitted within six (6) months of the claim being raised.

6.5 Uncollected Items

Items uncollected by you for a period of three (3) months after the Order is completed will be deemed abandoned and may be disposed of or donated to charity.
